description: Header file defining the HTTPUpload class for sending multipart HTTP POST requests using WinInet, including methods for request generation, response handling, and file content retrieval.
external_methods: WinInet API functions (implied by usage of HINTERNET and related functions)

classes.name: HTTPUpload
classes.description: Class providing static methods to perform multipart HTTP POST requests, handle responses, and manage request data.

methods.name: SendRequest
methods.description: Sends a multipart POST request with parameters and files to a specified URL, returning success status and optionally the response body and code.

methods.name: ReadResponse
methods.description: Retrieves the HTTP response content, checking content length if response is NULL.

methods.name: GenerateMultipartBoundary
methods.description: Creates a new boundary string for multipart form data.

methods.name: GenerateRequestHeader
methods.description: Generates the HTTP request header for multipart form submission.

methods.name: GenerateRequestBody
methods.description: Constructs the multipart request body from parameters and files.

methods.name: GetFileContents
methods.description: Reads file contents into a vector of characters.

methods.name: WideToMBCP
methods.description: Converts UTF16 string to specified code page encoding.

methods.name: CheckParameters
methods.description: Validates parameter names for printable ASCII characters and absence of quotes.
